stories.headline: Canadian sawmill output rises in August while shipments fall
stories.body: Canadian sawmills produced 3.674 million cubic metres of lumber in August, up 4.0% from July but down 3.8% from a year earlier, Statistics Canada reported November 4.

featuredResource.title: Timber Harvesting Systems in the Northeastern US / Northeastern Logging Productivity Spectrum
featuredResource.description: This two-page PDF infographic presents northeastern timber-harvesting systems and the factors that influence logging productivity. It highlights how timber size, harvest intensity, terrain, extraction distance and operator skill affect the balance between felling and wood extraction.
